```{python}
import decoupler as dc
import scanpy as sc
from decoupler.pp import pseudobulk
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from seaborn import objects as so
```

```{python}
cars = sc.read("4_car_no_gd_psuedotime.h5ad")
```

```{python}
outcome_info = {"P01":"persistence","P02":"persistence", "P03":"persistence", "P05":"persistence", "P06":"persistence", "P08":"no_persistence", "P09":"no_persistence",
"P10":"no_persistence", "P11":"no_persistence", "P13":"no_persistence"
}

cars.obs["outcome"] = (
    cars.obs["Patient"]
    .map(outcome_info)
    .astype("category")
)
```

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(cars, color=["labels", "outcome", "lineage_group"])
```

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(cars, color=["lineage_group"], palette=["mediumvioletred", "indianred", "royalblue", "grey"])
```

```{python}
cars.obs["Patient_Timepoint"] = (cars.obs["Patient"].astype(str) + "_" + cars.obs["Timepoint_bin"].astype(str))
```

```{python}
counts = pd.crosstab(
    cars.obs["lineage_group"],
    cars.obs["Timepoint_bin"]
)
props = counts.div(counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0)
props= props * 100
props.head()
```

```{python}
props = props.reset_index()
props = props.melt(id_vars = "lineage_group", var_name = "celltype", value_name = "percent")
```

```{python}
p = (
    so.Plot(props, x="lineage_group", y="percent", color="celltype")
    .scale(color="tab20")
    .add(so.Bar(), so.Stack())
    .theme({
        "axes.facecolor": "w", 
        "axes.edgecolor": "grey"})
    .layout(size=(8,4))
)

p.save("car_only/lineage_group_time_proportions.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
```
